scope: Paired comparison of the bulk-read patch against the pre-patch binary of the same commit; used only to decide whether the patch had an effect at all.
workload: CUEXIS_FOLLOW_COUNTS=1800 2000 2000, test 'PD finite read and update scaling'

patched.note: incrementally rebuilt with the bulk read; the binary was replaced by the reverted rebuild afterwards, so its hash is not recoverable from this state

decision: the patch made the read path slightly slower; hypothesis falsified, change reverted
patch_summary: PresentationRead::objectCount() plus readSnapshotObjectInto(index, out) replaced readSnapshotObject(index) -> Result<ObjectVisualRead>; the materializer validates once per frame and fills a reused row in place; snapshotReadScratchBytes 256 -> 136.
